verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n guroo gursikh dha(n)n aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|

en.bdb: The blest is disciple as well as the Guru who has made the disciple to pray before the primeval Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਧੰਨ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: satigur dharasan dha(n)n hai dha(n)n dhisaT gur dhiaan dharaiaa|

en.bdb: Blessed is the glimpse of the true Guru and that vision is also blessed one which peeps the mind concentrated upon the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n dha(n)n satigur sabadh dha(n)n surat gur giaan sunaiaa|

en.bdb: The Word of the true Guru and that meditational faculty is also blessed which has made the mind sustain the true knowledge bestowed by Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਗੁਰ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval gur dha(n)n dha(n)n dha(n)n masatak gur charanee laiaa|

en.bdb: Blessed are the lotus feet of the Guru along with that forehead which rests upon the feet of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਧੰਨੁ ਰਿਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤੁ੍ਰ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n dha(n)n gur upadhes hai dha(n)n ridhaa gur ma(n)tur vasaiaa|

en.bdb: Auspicious is the teaching of the Guru and that heart is a blessed one wherein resides the Guru manta.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਚਰਣਾਮਤੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਮੁਹਤ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n dha(n)n gur charanaamato dha(n)n muhat jit apio peeaaiaa|

en.bdb: Auspicious is the wash of Guru’s feet’s and that wisdom is also blessed one which understanding its importance has tasted that rare nectar.
This way, the gurmukhs have endured the unsustainable delight of the fruit of Guru’s Glimpse.
